title: Part Fifteen: Emanuela Orlandi and Mirella Gregori

sections.brief: Gregori (7 May 1983) and Orlandi (22 June 1983): who they were, the last sightings, the callers 'Pierluigi', 'Mario' and 'l'Americano', the Vatican hot line and the Agca exchange demand, the Turkesh communiqués, John Paul II's Angelus appeal of 3 July and home visit of 24 December 1983; why the case touches the Holy See. Figures: fig-time

Grading method (documented / reported / speculation / refuted); Agca/Grey Wolves; Magliana and De Pedis (Sant'Apollinare burial, 2012 opening); IOR/Marcinkus (Minardi 2008); abuse theories incl. Pietro Orlandi's April 2023 audio and Francis's reply; Fittipaldi 2017 memo and denial; the uncle (July 2023); cover-up claims vs the Holy See's position. Figures: fig-compare

Rome inquiries (1997 dismissal; 2015 archiving by GIP Giorgianni; Cassation 2016); nunciature bones 2018; Teutonic Cemetery 11 July 2019 and ossuaries; Diddi's Vatican file (9 Jan 2023); Rome's third investigation (May 2023, Dec 2025 suspect); Law 202/2023 commission, De Priamo, Giani hearing, archive files, 2026 sittings, no report as of Oct 2026; family's position. Figures: fig-time
